completions.summary: D113: fixed the operator-reported bug where opening a 3rd-party/doc screen (About dialog's Credits/Privacy/Third-party/Source-build links) could not be backed out of without resetting or closing the game. Root cause: real target=_blank navigation to a relative .md file, which in the Capacitor Android WebView unloads the whole app instead of opening a tab. Fixed ProductInfo.js's own links (fetch+render in-app) and added Global.BindNavigationGuard, a single delegated click listener (js/Global.js, loaded by both index.html and play.html) that blocks any relative-link navigation everywhere, present or future, per operator instruction to add one general backstop rather than hunting every instance.

D114: fixed operator-reported, pre-existing bug where Download map/Text export/transcript/save-package exports silently did nothing on the Android APK (Save map to a named localStorage slot worked fine, since it needs no OS file interaction). Root cause: MainActivity.java is a bare BridgeActivity with no download handling, and Android WebView doesn't reliably fire download handling for blob: URLs at all -- the shared ParchLockQol.DownloadText's <a download> blob-anchor click did nothing. Fixed by adding @capacitor/filesystem + @capacitor/share (npm install + cap sync, auto-registered like @capacitor/app already was) so DownloadText writes to the app's Cache dir and opens the native share sheet on Android, falling back to the original technique everywhere else. Checked and ruled out an equivalent bug in Module Manager (import-only, native file picker, no export path). Also fixed a real latent bug in D113's navigation guard: it didn't exempt [download] anchors by attribute, which would have blocked these very same blob: export links -- fixed by exempting any [download] link regardless of scheme. Full build-android.bat dev succeeded with both new native plugins compiled in.

D115: hardware back button no longer silently exits/minimizes/resets the app. Operator confirmed the underlying game (in-fiction MORE/CharInput prompts like '[Please press SPACE.]') works fine via keyboard -- only the Android back-button/back-swipe path was wrong, jumping straight to CapApp.exitApp() with nothing else open (not a Message/dialog/radial/map state, since D111 deliberately excludes native BufferWindow CharInput prompts from the auto arrow-pad). Fixed: the final fallback now requires confirm('Exit ParchLock?') first, same mechanism already used for Reset Map/Remove all modules; every earlier-priority dismiss case (tutorial/arrow-pad/radial/dialog/map) is untouched; a genuinely unexpected internal error still exits immediately as a last resort. Considered and rejected auto-submitting the expected keystroke, since read_char carries no metadata on what key is expected (same limitation D111 documents) -- guessing risks sending the wrong command into an unrelated char-prompt. Full build-android.bat dev succeeded with this fix included alongside D112-D114.

D116: fixed operator-reported 'top of the screen isn't touch capable' bug. Root cause: #exits .row.horizontal.top (the N/NE/NW compass strip, including its note icon) and the standalone #current-room-notes icon both had hardcoded top offsets with zero safe-area-inset accounting, unlike every other top-anchored mobile element in the stylesheet. On a phone with an edge-to-edge status bar, those touch targets render partially/fully under the system status bar, so taps land on the OS chrome instead of the WebView. Fixed by shifting both down by the real env(safe-area-inset-top) on mobile only (var(--pl-safe-top), the same variable/pattern already used everywhere else in this file); desktop untouched. Full build-android.bat dev succeeded with this fix alongside D112-D115.

D117 prototype implemented: player-initiated directional radial only (dime handle -> press-hold -> compass rose of current room's real exits -> slide-to-highlight -> release-to-submit via Actionable.Submit). Default ON, pulsing idle state, Pointer Events + setPointerCapture (works with mouse on desktop for free). Operator's requested layout: Up/Down on N/S's angle at an outer ring, In/Out on E/W's radius offset in angle. Explicitly NOT built: settings UI, per-module storage, D111 arrow-pad merge, D63 numbered-exit support, keyboard-only trigger -- all still only in docs/directional-radial-plan-d117.md. Caught and fixed a real hit-test bug during testing (ring-tolerance windows overlapped, causing array-order-dependent mis-hits at the boundary) via the harness itself, not inspection. build-android.bat dev succeeded.

D117 prototype: fixed two real defects the operator found live-testing. (1) Edge-of-screen reach: added chaseIfNeeded so the ring shifts toward the finger once it presses beyond the ring's usable radius, clamped to viewport. (2) Pill overlap ('all over the place, no circular pattern'): In/Out were only 22deg from E/W on the same ring -- less arc-length than a pill's own width, so e.g. e+in rooms always overlapped. Fixed by moving In/Out to the outer ring (same treatment as Up/Down already had) and widened radii; added an exhaustive test proving every same-ring pair in the whole layout is >=45deg apart with real clearance, not just one example. build-android.bat dev succeeded.

D116 follow-up: fixed operator-reported regression where the top compass strip/note icon now landed on or under the in-app Glk status banner (Deck Nine/Score/Turns) instead of the OS status bar. Root cause: --pl-safe-top alone only clears the OS status bar; #windowport itself starts below that PLUS the restored status GridWindow's own dynamic height, which had no CSS representation. Fixed by measuring GridWindow.reverse's real rendered height live in MobileLayout.apply() into a new --pl-statusbar-h variable (same discipline as --pl-kb-inset) and adding it to both elements' top offset. harness/exits-safe-area.js extended to 7/7. build-android.bat dev succeeded.
